answer: In PoA, every agent must forge original reasoning that a quorum of peers grades blind; fake identities cannot bridge the gap because each Sybil still owes genuine judgment under the same rubric. The attacker's cost scales with the delta between cheap identity and expensive cognition: spin up a thousand wallets and you still owe a thousand defensible answers, each slashable when the grading quorum catches template spam. Minting Sybils is free; verified judgment never is.
